eventMetadata.context_description: Persistent inflation pressures from Middle East energy shocks, including May CPI at 4.2% year-over-year, drove the June 2026 FOMC—under new Chair Kevin Warsh—to hold the federal funds target at 3.50%-3.75% for the fourth straight meeting while lifting the median end-2026 dot-plot projection to 3.8%. Nine participants now see at least one hike this year amid revised PCE forecasts of 3.6% for 2026. A resilient labor market with 4.3% unemployment and steady job gains reinforces the higher-for-longer stance, though core PCE near 2.9% offers some offset. Traders monitor the July CPI release, upcoming employment data, and subsequent FOMC meetings for signals on whether policy firming or delayed easing materializes before 2027.

markets.question: Next Token Sale on Coinbase by October 31, 2026?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a qualifying Coinbase token sale request window goes live between the creation of this market and the specified date at 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

To qualify, a Coinbase token sale request window must be live and actively accepting commitments.

Qualifying sales must be hosted directly by Coinbase on coinbase.com/token-sales or any official successor page within the Coinbase app or website. Sales run on a project's own site via Sonar, Echo, or any Coinbase-powered white-label technology do not qualify, regardless of affiliation. Private sales, airdrops, standard exchange listings, and any sale without a dedicated public request window do not qualify. Sale announcements, previews, and waitlists do not constitute a live request window. A request window that opens and is subsequently cancelled, paused, or suspended still resolves to "Yes" — post-opening outcomes including cancellation, refunds, pauses, or failure to distribute tokens do not affect resolution. If a sale is announced but the request window never opens, or a token is listed directly without a request window, this market resolves to "No".

The resolution source is coinbase.com/token-sales, official Coinbase blog posts, or @Coinbase/@CoinbaseMarkets on X, corroborated by credible news sources.

markets.question: Will El Salvador hold $1b+ of BTC by December 31, 2026?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the bitcoin holdings officially owned by the Republic of the El Salvador government reaches or surpasses a value of $1b at any point by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The primary resolutions source for this market will be the ARKHAM INTEL tracker (see: https://intel.arkm.com/explorer/entity/el-salvador). Any temporary glitches or errors in the tracker will not be considered. If the tracker becomes permanently unavailable another credible source may be used. Official announcements form the government of El Salvador confirming their bitcoin holdings have reached or surpassed $1b in value will also qualify.
